notes.title: Riding Out Version "Early Beta 1.4" is here!
notes.content:
Today we present you this little update with all the needed functions, before we can add the next big update.

[h1]Release notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved KI.
[*]More setting options (adjustable volume, for music and sounds).
[*]Save game slots (you can have as many game slots as you want).
[*]Bug fix for the horse status.
[*]Walls and foundations can be moved up and down, even after locked in. (it can be set back with „X“).
[*]You can sleep in the beds now. (skip a few ingame hours)
[*]You can save while playing.
[*]You can send us bugs directly while playing by pressing ESC.
[*]You can open the gate at Stefans meadow now. (His horses can’t run away).
[*]Bug fix for the paddock doors.
[*]Bug fix for the seeds.(Was not properly displayed).
[*]Bug fix for the price of the currycomb.
[*]Performance improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Riding Out Version "Early Beta 1.1" is here!
notes.content:
[h1]Release notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Some changes to the camera perpective.
[*]Added Wood to sell and harvest.
[*]New Trade system (You can choose your goods in the shelves).
[*]Sidequests available
[*]Added Sidequests.
[*]New places in the world added.
[*]New horse added.
[*]Horses need food from now on.
[*]You need to care for the horses from now on.
[*]Added affection to the horses (all horses from old save games will have 0 affection, you need to feed them a little bit or brush them with the currycomb, otherwise you cant ride it).
[*]New tools.
[*]New food for the horses.
[*]Horse gender is now show up in the name window.
[*]Performance improvements.
[*]Day-/Night speed improved.
[*]Fixed known bugs (Gameplay and Buildmode).
[*]Horse status overlay added.
[*]Questjournal added, where you can switch between active quests with the key J.
[*]Some Item prices are changed now.
[*]Added collectibles.
[*]New items added.
[*]Added new Characters to the world.
[/list]

To start the new sidequests, you need to take a look around in the town and other places for people or other things who will start the quest.

We recommend to start a new save game to prevent errors from a older state of the game.

With the next update we will add more quests and the horse equipment.

notes.title: Riding Out is back!
notes.content:
[h1]Back to it's roots![/h1]

We brought the old single player version of the game back and optimized it a little bit.
There is also a free demo version out, which will only have the basic functions in it.

You can buy it from steam or in the near future from our own shop at www.unexevo.de-
The free version will be on steam, as soon as steam gives you access to it.
We will keep the price on steam, but on our website, the game will be a little bit cheaper. :)

That was a lot of work to recreate everything and we almost had to start from the scratch.
The game is still in development and a lot of functions will be added later in the game.

That's why the village is a ghost town for example and the quests aren't fully implemented yet.
(The quests which are in it yet, are the same as before, but it will continue differently)

A few changes and improvements:
[list]
[*]It is possible to lead horses and tie them to objects.
[*]Horses won't just stand still anymore
[*]You can lead a horse, even if you are riding another one. (Perfect if you want to look for wildhorses ;) )
[*]The old building mode is improved. Every object can be colored now and a lot of objects can be colored on every side.
[*]New pieces for the editor.
[*]New help system for the editor, to make sure everything finds its right place.
[*]Performance update (You still have to furfill the requirements, otherwise it will be still lagging)
[*]Inventory with slots
[*]New horse animations
[/list]

(If you find bugs, please use our forum at www.unexevo.de or www.ridingout.de. You can tell us in the comments as well, but it is easier for us over the website :) )

Last but not least: Have fun and a happy new year to the riding out family from the team. Oh, and thank you for the patience.

[*]You can lead a horse, even if you are riding another one. (Perfect if you want to look for wildhorses ; ) )
[*]The old building mode is improved. Every object can be colored now and a lot of objects can be colored on every side.
[*]New help system for the editor, to make sure everything finds its right place.
[*]Performance update (You still have to furfill the requirements, otherwise it will be still lagging)

notes.content:
[h1]Release notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]You get 50% more gold for crafted items.
[*]Crafting can now be stopped and you'll get your items back.
[*]If you leave the game or if you use the obelisk the crafting will be stopped.
[/list]

Information about the building areas:

This building area is the first building area. And has the category "City", which means properties are near to each other in every size. The next zone will be in the category "meadow", which means less properties but bigger ones and not that close to each other. (Better if you want to ride around.)
